notes: Context: Small SaaS building a chat-first support widget for SMB customers. Trialing Redwood Hosted API (self-serve).
Primary ask: stable streaming + function/tool-calling so their client can call backend product lookup tool and render structured JSON responses reliably.
Environment: using AWS us-west-2, front-end SPA parses streaming chunks and calls JSON.parse per frame. Using Redwood SDK fetch-stream wrapper.

Observed problem: intermittent JSON.parse errors in browser. Errors occur when a function/tool call event is emitted mid-stream; front-end sees partial JSON (chunk boundary) and throws. Example client error: 'Unexpected end of JSON input' when trying to parse concatenated partial events.

Customer reported that function schema defined on their side expects 'tool_name' + 'arguments' object. In a sample failing trace we saw Redwood stream send event type 'tool_call' with 'name' field but 'arguments' payload arrived in a subsequent chunk without the surrounding braces — parser fails.

They also tried JSON mode (structured output) with a pre-declared schema for 'order_lookup' tool. When the model emits a function_call, the SDK returns a single aggregated message in some cases and chunked events in others. Inconsistency is killing their deterministic parser logic.
Customer quote: 'Works fine in postman but in the client it's a mess — sometimes we get two separate events and our parser chokes.'

Attempted workarounds so far: increased client buffer timeout, naive re-concat loop, switching to non-streaming to avoid parse errors (but increases latency and cost). They prefer streaming to show live typing + incremental tool results.

SE notes: likely causes — (1) frontend parser assumes each SSE/data event contains a full JSON object (false for chunked streaming), (2) mismatch in naming between customer's function schema and the model's emitted 'name' field (e.g., camelCase vs snake_case), (3) our SDK's streaming framing needs to be surfaced (boundary markers or explicit 'chunk_complete' events).

Logs attached in drive: Redwood POC notes + example raw event dump (drive link above). INF-4321 contains backend trace and a suggested small change to server-side framing logic to ensure 'data: [COMPLETED]' style delimiter before closing braces.
Priority: medium (SMB, low ARR now) but high for UX — they will choose alternative vendor if integration costs balloon.

Suggested next actions: 1) Book 60m session with dev & front-end engineer to reproduce; 2) Provide a short snippet for robust client-side streaming JSON assembly (with buffer + bracket counting); 3) Run a focused experiment to emit explicit chunk-end markers from Hosted API (engineering ticket created); 4) Validate function schema field names and types — recommend canonical schema to avoid name mismatch.
Short-term workaround agreed: customer to switch to 'non-streaming' for critical paths and try 'streaming' for non-blocking UI only until fix validated.
Long-term ask: SDK should expose a helper 'reassembleStreamingJSON' and an option to force 'single-aggregate' function_call responses for tool-calling flows.
